fixes.explanation: Jesus says, “But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.” Think about it. Nobody shows up to a wedding with a long face while the groom is standing right there. The mourning waits until He's taken from them. So the fasting isn't about a rule, it's about who is in the room.

Nobody's cancelling anything here, baker. Jesus says, “But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.” The wedding stays on the calendar the whole time. The change He names is the bridegroom being taken from them, and that's when the fasting starts.
